records.title: Unifying Group-Relative and Self-Distillation Policy Optimization via Sample Routing
records.reason: Full text describes sample routing between GRPO and self-distillation branches during policy optimization/post-training. It notes shorter output responses can incidentally lower inference cost, but does not propose or measure an inference-time optimization; its core contribution is training convergence and final reasoning quality.

records.title: MUSt3R: Multi-view Network for Stereo 3D Reconstruction
records.reason: The linked full text identifies MUSt3R as a multi-view stereo 3D reconstruction network addressing pairwise view scaling and alignment. Despite a misleading lineage association, the actual input, task, model contribution, and experiments are computer vision geometry rather than LLM inference.

records.title: UI-R1: Enhancing Efficient Action Prediction of GUI Agents by Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The paper applies rule-based reinforcement learning to improve GUI action-prediction accuracy; the primary abstract describes efficient dataset/training setup, not reduced inference cost.

records.title: Convolutional Neural Network in Medical Image Analysis: A Review
records.reason: The primary Springer page exposes the abstract but gates the article text behind institutional access. The visible abstract describes a CNN medical-image review and mentions large-scale retrieval efficiency, but the linked sparse-attention lineage cannot be resolved responsibly from the abstract alone. Full primary-body evidence is therefore unavailable and the candidate remains borderline.

records.title: Large Language Models for Data Annotation: A Survey
records.reason: The survey focuses on use of LLMs for data annotation, assessment, and downstream utilization; it is an application survey rather than an inference-system improvement.
